top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A reviewed child's file did not have the completed water activity permission.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple record keeping items were not made available to the Child Care Regulation Inspector for review at the time of the monitoring inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.

top_violation_types.title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found to be deficient. A caregiver admitted to placing the blanket on the child's head and can be seen doing so in a video.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff files reviewed did not have the required Health and Safety training topic certificates for the last full year of training.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.
